requirement_matrix.actual_implementation: RegionalConditioner in conditioning/regional_conditioner.py and PromptBuilder using native SD 75-token BREAK chunking and column weighting

requirement_matrix.actual_implementation: LoRARegistry in conditioning/lora_registry.py scanning models/Lora and formatting <lora:name:weight> tokens

requirement_matrix.actual_implementation: RefinementController in conditioning/refinement.py using ReActor v0.7.1-b3 + CodeFormer v0.1.0 in Pass 2 img2img
requirement_matrix.evidence: adetailer extension is not installed; ReActor + CodeFormer successfully restored high-frequency facial landmarks on all scenes
requirement_matrix.remaining_work: Install adetailer extension if YOLO bbox inpainting is preferred over ReActor

requirement_matrix.actual_implementation: CrossFrameConditioner in conditioning/crossframe_conditioner.py tracking frame history and Visual DNA anchors
requirement_matrix.evidence: True cross-frame self-attention tensor sharing (StoryDiffusion) is not implemented in SD Forge; substituted via Visual DNA Anchors + IP-Adapter cross-attention
requirement_matrix.remaining_work: Implement custom PyTorch batch cross-attention hooks if true tensor sharing is required
